title: Lisa Murray Released A New Single Called "Stuck On You"
htmlContent:
Lisa Murray is an angelic and smooth singer who invests in a broader sound that offers something more universal. 

In her new single, "Stuck On You," her music transits between house and synth-pop, with a striking beat and traveling synthesizers, with her beautiful voice as the icing on the cake. 

If you like modern music with an up-to-date and contemporary sound, you should check out Lisa Murray's new work. The track sounds like current R&B, but it flirts very well with alternative music and solid hip-hop influences. The result is a charming song.
